call_points.text: Seven new logos added in FY26 versus three in FY25.
Most new orders came from India and the US, with a few from other geographies.
Revenue from the order book will lag by one or two quarters due to implementation cycles.
Employee cost rose partly due to new labour code changes, management said.
Bajaj Finance exited as a customer because it invested in a competitor, the CFO said.
Headcount at quarter end was about 2,000, broadly stable over recent quarters.
Japan discussions with top banks are active and results may come in upcoming quarters.

timeline.summary: Yogesh Andlay, Promoter, declared no encumbrance on shares held by him or persons acting in concert for FY2026 under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4).
Nucleus Software received an income tax demand of ₹0.28 crore for AY 2023-24 following transfer pricing adjustments.
Shareholders passed all six postal ballot resolutions on 7 May 2026, including Parag Bhise's re-appointment as CEO, Dr. Nitin Gokarn as Independent Director and the Nucleus Software RSU Scheme-2026.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹224.77 Cr (-1.8% YoY), net profit ₹34.55 Cr (-46.7% YoY).
Nucleus Software Exports Limited’s Board recommended **Rs. 12.50 final dividend per equity share (125% of face value) for FY2025-26**, pending shareholder approval at AGM.
Nucleus Software reported FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹876.03 Cr and PAT of ₹116.74 Cr
Nucleus Software provided the audio transcript link for its Q4FY26 earnings conference call on May 22, 2026.
Nucleus Software's Q4FY26 earnings call disclosed an order book of ₹1,044.31 Cr at 31 March 2026, up from ₹656.68 Cr at 31 December 2025, with seven new logos added in FY26.
16 Oct 2026: Nucleus Software's GenAI Visual Report Agent, part of FinnOne Neo, won the 'Most Innovative Practice' award at the 3rd CII National AI Awards 2026.
